name: Poly Property Services Co., Ltd.
summary: Poly Property Services Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a property management service provider in China. The company offers property management services for residential communities under the Oriental Courtesy, Elegant Life, and Harmony Courtyard brands; trinity services, including property management, asset management, and corporate services for commercial and office buildings under the Nebula Ecology brand; and public services under the Poly Public Services brand.
